67	/**
68	 * Create a new Stripe Connect Express account for a studio or artist, then
69	 * record it via the stripe_connected_account_create RPC.
70	 *
71	 * IDEMPOTENCY: keyed by (studio_id, type, artist_id?) — retrying the same
72	 * logical operation returns the same Stripe account (Stripe dedupes by key).
73	 * The RPC is also idempotent: it inserts with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.
74	 *
75	 * Capabilities requested:
76	 *  - card_payments + transfers: always (required for platform charges)
77	 *  - tax_reporting_us_1099_nec: only for artist accounts (1099-NEC annual export)

86	  supabase: SupabaseClient,
87	  args: CreateConnectAccountArgs,
88	): Promise<CreateConnectAccountResult> {

90	
91	  const idemKey = idempotencyKeyFor('connect.account.create', {
92	    studio_id: args.studioId,
93	    type: args.type,
94	    artist_id: args.artistId ?? null,
95	  })

98	    stripe.accounts.create(

101	        country: args.country,
102	        default_currency: args.defaultCurrency,
103	        email: args.email,
104	        capabilities: {

106	          transfers: { requested: true },

108	          ...(args.type === 'artist'

111	        },
112	        metadata: {
113	          inkos_idempotency_key: key,
114	          inkos_studio_id: args.studioId,
115	          inkos_account_type: args.type,
116	          ...(args.artistId ? { inkos_artist_id: args.artistId } : {}),
117	        },
118	      },

"Continue verification" redirects to `/api/billing/connect/refresh-link?type=studio` (which Track A 302s to fresh Stripe URL).

- `/components/settings/payments/ConnectOnboardingRejected.tsx` — Server Component. Stone bg, no Rust. Instrument Serif italic headline for the bad news. Two ghost buttons: Stripe support (external) + InkOS email (`mailto:`). Uses `render={}` pattern.
- `/components/settings/payments/ConnectActiveOverview.tsx` — Server Component. "Connected & ready." header. `CapabilityRow` for all 4 capabilities. Single Rust LIVE pulse on "Charges enabled". Last-4-char masked account ID (`acct_•••xxxx`). Stripe dashboard link opens in new tab.
- `/components/settings/payments/ConnectReturnHandler.tsx` — Client Component. Reads `?onboarding=complete&type=studio` params on mount. Fires Stone-tinted toast (no `title`, just description — editorial restraint). Calls `router.refresh()` to pick up DB changes. Cleans URL with `history.replaceState`.
- `/components/dashboard/ConnectOnboardingBanner.tsx` — Client Component. Fetches connect status client-side. 4 states: no account (dismissible via localStorage), pending, restricted (2px Rust left-border), rejected. Active state returns null. Uses `render={<Link>}` pattern for button-as-link.
- `/lib/settings/navigation.ts` — Added `Wallet` icon import + "In-studio payments" entry in the Billing group, positioned after "Usage", visible to `BILLING_SETTINGS_PERMISSIONS`.
- `/components/today/TodayClient.tsx` — Wired `ConnectOnboardingBanner` above the overdue alert banner, guarded to `owner | admin` roles only.

Onboarding flow summary: no account → `ConnectOnboardingCallToAction` shows → POST `/api/billing/connect/onboard` → `window.location.assign(url)` to Stripe KYC → Stripe redirects to `/settings/payments?onboarding=complete&type=studio` → `ConnectReturnHandler` fires toast + `router.refresh()` → page re-fetches DB → status banner reflects new state.
